SEIRD compartmental model (susceptible-exposed-infectious-recovered-dead)

Source: R/jump_model.R
seird_model.Rd

Extends SIRD with an exposed (non-infectious, incubating) compartment, the natural extension for diseases with an appreciable incubation period such as COVID-19. State: (s, e, i, r), with the death fraction implicit as 1 - s - e - i - r. Events: infection (S+I -> E+I, rate lambda*s*i), progression (E -> I, rate sigma*e), recovery (I -> R, rate gamma*i) and disease-induced death (I -> (implicit D), rate alpha*i).

Usage

seird_model()

Value

A jump_model with compartments c("s","e","i","r") and parameters lambda, sigma, gamma, alpha.
